reviews.quote: The other travellers were so nice, as well as the manager and the volunteers! It was the best hostel I stayed in in Albania. The beds also give you some privacy and the rooftop bar is really nice. Stayed here for almost a week!
reviews.author: Paul, United Kingdom

reviews.quote: Gorgeous rooms, fabulous roof top bar, amazing staff. Although I only stayed one night, it was undoubtedly the best hostel of my trip. Bathrooms were clean, very central location. Faultless.
reviews.author: Peig, Ireland

reviews.quote: I had a great experience at the hostel! At first I only wanted to stay one night but I actually ended up staying for six nights. The vibe was great, great people, great staff! Special thanks to Rob the hostel manager for making the stay so memorable in showing us around and making life easy!
reviews.author: Anton, Germany

reviews.quote: One of the best hostels I've ever stayed at! Super clean, beds are comfy, and the rooftop bar is legendary. Such a social atmosphere where everyone is hanging out together. The staff are great and it's in the perfect location. Only booked a couple nights and ended up extending, like most people did.
reviews.author: Sherye, Australia

reviews.quote: Loved this hostel so much! Most amazing view from the terrace, breakfast was always fresh and staff were so welcoming and always willing to help! Loved the hostel and Shkoder so much that I kept extending my stay!
reviews.author: Male, 18-24, Italy

reviews.quote: Top tier hostel! Modern spacious beds with well air conditioned rooms. Perfect location right in town. High-energy and social place to stay with amazing rooftop drinks. Was super easy to organise day trips around the city through staff. Clean facilities and beautiful roof top terrace!
reviews.author: Mollie, New Zealand

reviews.quote: I loved how Rob made my stay comfortable and safe. He made sure that everyone felt good and was always asking me and others if we needed help with anything. He took me and another guest to a nearby local river with spots only few know of. I also loved how clean everything was at the hostel! The hostel has a rooftop with the most beautiful view of the city.
reviews.author: Maria, Denmark

reviews.quote: Prime location, super comfy beds that feel like a small bedroom. Friendly, helpful staff, clean facilities, and a beautiful rooftop space to enjoy.
reviews.author: Female, 18-24, Canada

reviews.quote: Beds were so incredibly comfortable. The people, volunteers and owner were just amazing, so helpful and nice. The views from the rooftop were just incredible, and the location is to die for.
reviews.author: Piper, Australia
